hero.intro: I build modern web applications with Spring Boot, Angular and React – from the frontend to the cloud. I'm currently looking for a junior position in the Freiburg area or remote.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer from Tunisia, now living in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. I graduated in Software Engineering from ESPRIT in 2024.

In my final-year project at Insoméan Computer Solutions, I built a web application with Spring Boot and Angular, implemented single sign-on with Azure AD and deployed the application to the cloud with Azure DevOps. I have also delivered freelance projects – from e-commerce to machine-learning recommendation systems.

I enjoy the whole journey of an application – from the frontend and backend all the way to cloud deployment. I'm currently looking for a junior position in a modern tech environment in the Freiburg area or remote.

devops.title: DevOps Pipeline
devops.description: Complete CI/CD pipeline for a Spring Boot/Angular application with Jenkins and Docker, code quality with SonarQube and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.
